name: Dependency Security Audit (pip)
description: Scan a Python project’s requirements file for packages with known vulnerabilities using pip-audit on a schedule and write the findings to a report, the Python counterpart to the npm audit template.

parameters.label: Requirements file path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the requirements.txt to audit. The pip-audit tool must be installed, for example with pip install pip-audit.

parameters.label: Report file path
parameters.help: Where to write the audit report. pip-audit exits non-zero when it finds a vulnerable package, so the run shows as failed exactly when there is something to fix.
